headline: Roosevelt draw again and remain the division's longest unbeaten side
dek: Roosevelt's draw with Northern Michigan leaves their record still clear of a defeat, and no other unbeaten programme in the division has played as many matches. North Georgia, in the Peach Belt, are the next longest to have gone without losing.
displaced_by: results night: Roosevelt's draw with Northern Michigan keeps them unbeaten through more matches than any other unbeaten side in the division
